chapter: Making up numbers, bop and technique
title: Bands making up their own numbers; Banana Peeling and trio sections
summary: Miller says bands composed pieces so rivals could not top them, and tries Buddy's Banana Peeling, high society and Panama Rag trios.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Do guys make up many of their own numbers in their old days?

Yeah, they used to do that. They used to do that like, they had lots of them.
